findings.detail: The recommendations say what to do but omit why: David and Susan wanted to simplify their accounts. The earlier account value is also more detail than the specification calls for in the high-level Background & Objectives section.
report_quote: We recommend disinvesting the joint GIA in full.
Your joint General Investment Account was previously shown in our records (15 March) as £40,000.

findings.detail: The meeting note describes a live account value of a little over £45,000, not an amount established as the eventual sale proceeds. Although ‘c.’ signals an estimate, the report slightly shifts the basis of that figure.
report_quote: We recommend using the gross proceeds of c. £45,000 to top up David's and Susan's Stocks & Shares ISAs for the new tax year, split equally between the two ISAs.

findings.detail: The report distinguishes the older recorded GIA value from the more recent figure, identifies the joint account as jointly held, and does not expose the internal handling notes.
The repeated ‘We recommend’ is unnecessary, and ‘disinvesting’ and ‘CGT’ make the advice less plain than it could be. CGT is not expanded until the following section.
